name: SCR Stüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to SCR Stüberl – your cozy mountain retreat in the heart of Tirol!**

Nestled in the picturesque landscape near **Innsbruck**, this charming **Stüberl** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a warm, rustic setting. Whether you're craving a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** with fresh fruit compote, a savory **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a comforting bowl of **Käsespätzle**, our menu is a celebration of regional flavors.

After your meal, unwind with a glass of local **Apfelstrudel** wine or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** by the crackling fireplace. The rustic wooden interiors and handcrafted details make every visit feel like a step back in time—yet with all the modern comforts you’d expect.

Just a short drive from the **Karwendel** and **Nordkette** mountains, SCR Stüberl is the perfect base for exploring Tirol’s breathtaking nature. Whether you're hiking, skiing, or simply soaking in the alpine views, our warm welcome and delicious cuisine will make your stay unforgettable.

**Come as a guest, leave as a friend—Tirol awaits!**
